name: Hotel Outside
beschreibung: Hotel Outside is situated in Matrei in Osttirol, surrounded by the dramatic 3,000-metre peaks of the Hohe Tauern National Park. The boutique hotel seamlessly combines alpine heritage with contemporary eco-conscious architecture. In winter, guests enjoy direct access to the Großglockner Resort Kals-Matrei ski area, while summer invites alpine hiking expeditions. Amenities include an organic nature spa with saunas and natural bathing pond, regional gourmet cuisine, and panoramic rooms.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Outside in Matrei in East Tyrol features eco-luxury design, a natural spa wellness area, organic regional dining, and views of the Hohe Tauern peaks.
